top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is mature, independently confirmed and backed by large randomized outcome trials. The prize should reward the discovery, which is the biology of the hormone: human incretin physiology (Holst), receptor biology and tissue actions (Drucker), and identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov). The therapeutic chain rests on that knowledge. P002 is a close second because Knudsen's acylation gave the durable drugs, but it shifts weight toward drug development. Mojsov and Habener priority remains unresolved from the files. No award is clearly worse than either GLP-1 trio.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Drucker, Holst, Mojsov or Knudsen
